headline: Yuken India responds to NSE volume surge inquiry
hook: Exchange seeks clarity on Yuken volume spike
summary: The National Stock Exchange (NSE) observed a significant increase in trading volume for Yuken India Limited. The exchange issued a formal query to the company to ensure market transparency and protect investor interests. Yuken India has since submitted its response to the exchange regarding the activity. This process is a standard regulatory procedure to address unusual market movements.
why_it_matters: Standard regulatory check on unusual stock trading activity.
